audience: designer-friendly marketplace curation with engineering gates
summary: Track trusted GitHub, MCP, Copilot, and model marketplace channels before any live install, listing, or credentialed write.
nonCoderWorkflow: Choose the marketplace card or source family that feels useful for SEIS.
Check the trust posture, visual fit, and user-facing value before technical activation.
Ask engineering automation to run the listed quality command.
Only publish or install live when target, auth, rollback owner, and user approval are explicit.

marketplaceChannels.label: GitHub MCP Registry
marketplaceChannels.gate: use only the smallest task-matched MCP server after target and permissions are known
marketplaceChannels.nextAction: shortlist official or high-trust MCP servers into the SEIS marketplace view

marketplaceChannels.label: GitHub Marketplace Actions
marketplaceChannels.gate: requires a public single-action repository with root action.yml or action.yaml and a release
marketplaceChannels.nextAction: promote only small reusable automation into a separate action repository

marketplaceChannels.label: GitHub Marketplace Apps
marketplaceChannels.gate: requires app listing requirements, publisher verification for paid plans, support details, and permission review
marketplaceChannels.nextAction: use only after SEIS has a clear app surface, support model, and install flow

marketplaceChannels.label: GitHub Models
marketplaceChannels.gate: treat as model sourcing, not a SEIS marketplace listing target
marketplaceChannels.nextAction: map trusted model providers to AI architecture notes when a workflow needs a model

marketplaceChannels.label: Awesome GitHub Copilot
marketplaceChannels.gate: package only clean, reusable SEIS instructions or skills with clear scope and no secrets
marketplaceChannels.nextAction: shape SEIS marketplace entries as plugin-ready resources before proposing upstream contribution

marketplaceChannels.label: GitHub App-based Copilot Extensions
marketplaceChannels.gate: blocked for new SEIS work because GitHub sunset this server-side extension path in favor of MCP
marketplaceChannels.nextAction: replace extension ideas with MCP server or plugin marketplace packaging

trustedSourceShortlist.designerValue: Convert documents and assets into Markdown for clean handoff and content operations.
Connect repo issues, pull requests, and workflow status to natural-language governance.
Bring Figma design context into implementation without losing design-system intent.
Move curated marketplace notes into a team knowledge base after destination approval.
Support future marketplace data storage when the product surface needs real records.
Prepare paid marketplace thinking without touching payments until product scope is clear.
Protect source code from leaked secrets before public marketplace growth.
Candidate hosting/deploy lane for polished public product surfaces.
Candidate CI lane when marketplace packaging needs stronger release verification.
Reference provider for future AI-assisted marketplace descriptions and content QA.

publishingPath.ownerAction: Curate cards, categories, descriptions, trust posture, and visual priority.
Choose which SEIS instruction, skill, or agent should become reusable.
publishingPath.engineeringGate: package manifest, license, no secrets, scoped docs

publishingPath.ownerAction: Choose the external system that genuinely improves the user workflow.
publishingPath.engineeringGate: target, auth, permissions, rollback owner, low-power test

publishingPath.ownerAction: Approve public brand, support copy, screenshots, and pricing or free positioning.
publishingPath.engineeringGate: separate public repo or app listing, publisher requirements, release process
